{{Top|leg}}
'''Engineering officer''' was an individual responsible for [[Engineer/Legends|engineering]] duties aboard a starship. According to a fake story formulated by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] in order to infiltrate [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]], [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Alfonso Luiz Obota|Hortu Agar]] was the engineering officer aboard the [[Transport/Legends|transport]] ''[[High Hauler]]''.

Engineering officer was a specialist rank used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Engineering Corps/Legends|Engineering Corps]]. It was the lowest [[Officer/Legends|officer]] rank of the Engineering Corps, ranking below [[Lieutenant/Legends|engineering lieutenant]]. The rank was the equivalent of [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Ensign/Legends|ensign]], [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] officer, and [[Starfighter Corps (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Starfighter Corps]] [[Flight officer/Legends|flight officer]].<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
